years.tagline: 7th grade — art, soccer, and science curiosity.

events.body: Created a five-piece watercolor series of front porches on our block. One piece was selected for the district spring show and displayed in the county library for six weeks.
Started every league match as a central midfielder. Helped the team go undefeated in league play and assisted the game-winning goal in the championship.

events.heading1: Science fair — pollinators in our yard
events.body: Counted bee visits on three native plants over four weeks and built a simple chart of peak activity times. Won first place in life sciences at the school fair.
Auditioned for a short solo in the winter concert and performed in front of 300 families. Practiced breath control and diction with my choir director for six weeks.
Learned positioning and passing in my first organized season. Coaches voted me most improved after I moved from defense to midfield mid-season.
